title: Clearance event payload (W4)
description: The decision of two clearers on a candidate (instructor, unit, modes), with the observation events it rests on. References and dates only: reasons stay in the clearers' sign-offs in the private store. A staffing check reads these events (records.clearances). Increment 3 added the optional `scope` (W11: a clearance limited to a partner organisation and/or to regions), an additive change that keeps the @1 id: every earlier @1 payload still validates, and a payload without a scope is unscoped. Decision 0017 added the optional `founding` (true when a clearer decided under the founding waiver, holding no clearance for the unit that day), additive in the same way: a payload without it was decided under the ordinary rule.

observations.description: Ids of the observation events the decision rests on

founding.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (decision 0017). Present only when at least one of the two clearers held no clearance for the unit on the day they decided: a founding round, allowed while fewer than two calibrated clearers other than the instructor hold the unit. Absent means the ordinary rule.

scope.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (decision 0014, W11). Who and where the clearance covers; absent means unscoped. A staffing check honours it: a scoped clearance does not cover other partners or regions.

regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, optionally with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision (IE, US-CA)
